       end\n            end\n\n            // Output update\n            if (!m_axis_tvalid_reg && (rd_ptr != wr_ptr)) begin\n                m_axis_tdata_reg <= mem_data[rd_ptr];\n                if (rd_byte_cnt == 0) begin\n                    m_axis_tid_reg <= mem_id[rd_frame_ptr];\n                    m_axis_tdest_reg <= mem_dest[rd_frame_ptr];\n                    m_axis_tuser_reg <= mem_user[rd_frame_ptr];\n                end\n                m_axis_tvalid_reg <= 1'b1;\n            end\n\n            // Ready when frame not full and FIFO not full\n            s_axis_tready_reg
